newsitem.title: USA: Baxter wins directed verdict in Texas case.
newsitem.headline: Baxter wins directed verdict in Texas case.

text.p: Baxter International Inc said Wednesday a federal judge granted a directed verdict in favor of its Baxter Healthcare Corp unit in a breast implant liability case.
The ruling late Tuesday marks the 21st verdict Baxter has won in breast implant lawsuits, the Deerfield, Illinois-based company said.

The ruling by U.S. District Judge Edward Prado was the first directed verdict -- one which is issued for the defense before the defense presents its case -- issued in a federal breast implant case, Baxter said.

"Judge Prado's decision is yet another in a recent series of federal court rulings finding there is no sound scientific evidence to support the claim that silicone breast implants cause systemic disease," Vaughn Crawford, lead trial attorney for Baxter, said in a news release.
Of 26 breast implant cases, Baxter has won 21 verdicts, lost three and had two end in mistrial. The three lost cases are either being appealed or are being re-tried, Baxter said.
Baxter shares clsoed down 1/4 at 48-1/2 Wednesday.
